svg.title: The money end of the market, 09.20
svg.desc: A row of market stalls with chalkboards, handwritten price cards, a discount sticker, a till, a second-hand equipment pitch and a phone screen showing an order.

g.text: The money end of the market, 09.20
Eleven prices in this picture. Three of them are for the same thing.
Mr Tan, the bill on the nail
